title: Toward System One Clinical Intelligence: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning and Counterfactual Explainability of Decision Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.15029v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated disease classification from patient-reported symptoms requires balancing the speed of lightweight discriminative models against the contextual understanding and latency costs of autoregressive large language models (LLMs). Decision foundation models offer an alternative by mapping representations directly to candidate classes without free-form text generation. We adapt Clef-Flash, a 9-billion-parameter decision model built on a Qwen3.5 backbone, for 24-class disease classification on the Symptom2Disease benchmark. Using 4-bit quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) with differential learning rates and a stratified split of 960 training and 240 test cases, the model achieves 95.42% diagnostic accuracy and a macro F1 score of 0.9551. translated_title: 迈向“系统一”临床智能：决策基础模型的参数高效微调与反事实可解释性
translated_abstract: 从患者报告的症状进行自动化疾病分类，需要在轻量级判别模型的推理速度与自回归大语言模型（LLM）的上下文理解能力和延迟成本之间取得平衡。决策基础模型提供了一种替代方案，它将表示直接映射到候选类别，而无需自由文本生成。我们对Clef-Flash（一个基于Qwen3.5骨干网络构建的90亿参数决策模型）进行了适配，用于Symptom2Disease基准上的24类疾病分类。通过采用带有差分学习率的4比特量化低秩适配（QLoRA），以及在960个训练案例和240个测试案例上的分层划分，该模型达到了95.42%的诊断准确率和0.9551的宏平均F1分数。这一结果优于已报告的远程API零样本基线（61.67%）和本地未适配初始化的零样本基线（65.00%），并超越了ClinicalBERT基线（90.90%）。通过评估候选诊断的反事实可解释性，该研究进一步增强了模型决策的透明度与可信度。
tldr: 该研究通过QLoRA参数高效微调将基于Qwen3.5的90亿参数决策基础模型Clef-Flash适配于24类疾病症状分类任务，取得95.42%的准确率并显著超越零样本基线与ClinicalBERT，同时结合反事实可解释性提升了临床决策的透明度。
en_tdlr: This study adapts the 9-billion-parameter decision foundation model Clef-Flash (built on Qwen3.5) for 24-class disease classification via QLoRA parameter-efficient fine-tuning, achieving 95.42% accuracy that surpasses zero-shot baselines and ClinicalBERT, while enhancing clinical decision transparency through counterfactual explainability.
